generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An evidence package can carry syntactically valid immutable-object identifiers that were never verified to exist or to correspond to the claimed source path on the certified revision.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate only evidence schema and SHA formatting, or accept any existing repository object, without resolving the certified revision and source path to the exact immutable object.

reusable_control.requirement: Require each declared immutable source object to exist with the expected object type and equal the object resolved from certified revision plus source path.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Generate source-proof identifiers only from the certified revision and declared source path; never copy or synthesize object identifiers without resolution.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Fail readiness when a declared source object is missing, has the wrong object type, or differs from the object resolved for the claimed path at the certified revision.

transfer_cases.scenario: A manifest names an existing object from a sibling artifact instead of the artifact path it claims to certify.
A source snapshot records a well-formed but nonexistent immutable object identifier.

skill_changes.evidence: repository validation contract integrated into the canonical validate command
skill_changes.change: Derive and verify source proof object identity from certified revision plus path before handoff.

skill_changes.evidence: generic exact-object validator with synthetic existing-wrong-path and nonexistent-object fixtures
skill_changes.change: Reject missing objects and exact path/object mismatches.
